debts.title: Legacy FastAPI/Celery/Redis stack still in repo
debts.resolution: Deleted backend/ (FastAPI, 91 files) and rewrote docker-compose.yml to a serverless-aligned slim stack (Ollama + whatsapp-gateway only). Postgres/Redis/Celery/backend removed.
debts.description_es: El backend FastAPI, el gateway legacy (gateway/, llama a backend:8000) y los servicios celery/redis/postgres de docker-compose siguen en el repo. La auditoría confirmó que backend/ SÍ es consumido por gateway/src/webhook.js y por el proxy de next.config.js, por lo que el borrado estaba bloqueado. Con la reforma v0.9.0 (Supabase+Netlify+scheduler) quedan fuera de alcance.
debts.description_en: FastAPI backend, legacy gateway (gateway/ → backend:8000) and docker-compose celery/redis/postgres remain. Audit confirmed backend/ IS consumed by gateway/src/webhook.js and the next.config.js proxy, which blocked deletion. With the v0.9.0 re-baseline they are out of scope.
debts.proposed_fix_es: 1) Fijar TD-007 (next.config). 2) Eliminar gateway/ legacy (usar whatsapp-gateway/ slim). 3) Borrar backend/. 4) Limpiar docker-compose (celery/redis/postgres/backend).
debts.proposed_fix_en: 1) Fix TD-007 (next.config). 2) Remove legacy gateway/ (use slim whatsapp-gateway/). 3) Delete backend/. 4) Clean docker-compose (celery/redis/postgres/backend).

debts.title: next.config.js contradicts Fase 8/9 (FastAPI proxy + standalone)
debts.resolution: Removed /api/* → backend:8000 rewrite and output:'standalone' from dashboard/next.config.js. Verified no dashboard code consumes /api or BACKEND_URL.
debts.description_es: next.config.js mantiene output:'standalone' (D007 SUPERSEDED) y reescribe /api/* → http://backend:8000 (FastAPI). El commit 0c013ae decía 'drop legacy BACKEND_URL' pero sigue presente. Riesgo en producción: rutas /api podrían apuntar a un backend inexistente en Netlify.
debts.description_en: next.config.js keeps output:'standalone' (D007 SUPERSEDED) and rewrites /api/* → http://backend:8000 (FastAPI). Commit 0c013ae claimed it was dropped but it remains. Production risk: /api routes could target a non-existent backend on Netlify.
debts.proposed_fix_es: Quitar el rewrite a backend y output:'standalone' (Netlify + @netlify/plugin-nextjs lo maneja).
debts.proposed_fix_en: Remove the backend rewrite and output:'standalone' (Netlify + @netlify/plugin-nextjs handles it).

debts.title: Duplicate WhatsApp gateways
debts.resolution: Deleted legacy gateway/. Added Dockerfile to slim whatsapp-gateway/ and pointed docker-compose at it.
debts.description_es: Coexisten gateway/ (legacy, FastAPI) y whatsapp-gateway/ (slim, supabase-js). docker-compose construye el legacy. Consolidar en el slim.
debts.description_en: gateway/ (legacy, FastAPI) and whatsapp-gateway/ (slim, supabase-js) coexist. docker-compose builds the legacy one. Consolidate on the slim gateway.
debts.proposed_fix_es: Eliminar gateway/ y apuntar el deploy al gateway slim.
debts.proposed_fix_en: Delete gateway/ and point deploy to the slim gateway.
